assessment: This study explores a role for the purinergic receptor P2RY14 and cAMP signaling in Schwann cell precursor self-renewal and neurofibroma development. Importantly, the authors show that genetic and chemical inhibition of P2RY14 inhibits Schwann cell precursor self-renewal in vitro and suppresses neurofibroma development in vivo. The authors also report that these effects are mediated by an increase in cAMP signaling.
